data.question_quote: I just had a question, firstly, on rate sensitivity because I can't find any tables or disclosure in today's releases. I guess, are you now approaching in regards to base rates, a position whereby the bank is liability sensitive? Or how should we think about rate sensitivity going forward?
data.answer_quote: Thanks for your questions, so I'll cover the first one and then hand across to Venkat. So you're exactly right. What we are saying is that given where base rates have now got to, we expect further rate rises from here would have no impact on our net interest margin, in fact it might be even slightly negative.
